products.title: Chic Pink Mermaid Scales Tankini Set for Mother and Daughter
products.descriptionHtml_sanitized:
• Embrace the siren call of the ocean with this charming tankini set, adorned with a delightful pink mermaid scale pattern for both mother and daughter.
  • The daughter's two-piece tankini features a flirty ruffle overlay, adding a dash of playful elegance to her swim attire.
  • Crafted with a blend of nylon and polyester for a snug yet comfortable fit that moves with you, making it perfect for all-day wear.
  • The mother's one-piece swimsuit showcases a classic tank style, providing coverage and support without sacrificing style.
  • Easy to care for and quick to dry, this swimsuit set is as practical as it is stylish, ensuring you stay comfortable whether you're lounging poolside or chasing waves at the beach.

Description: Step into a world of aquatic enchantment with our Pink Mermaid Scales Tankini Set, designed for both mother and daughter. The captivating scale pattern in shades of pink transports you to mythical underwater realms, while the ruffled details on the daughter's tankini top bring a sense of fun and frill to her swimwear. The fabric's elasticity ensures a flattering fit for various body shapes, providing the confidence to enjoy the sun, sea, and sand. Whether it's for a special mother-daughter day out or a family vacation, this tankini set is sure to be a hit, making every moment in the water an unforgettable one.
